no_adcom_quote.quote: FDA did not refer this NDA to an advisory committee because no review issues were identified that raised significant public health questions regarding the risk:benefit assessment of entrectinib for the proposed indication.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA212726 (Rozlytrek/entrectinib for NTRK fusion-positive solid tumors). The FDA Multidisciplinary Review states FDA did not refer the NDA to an advisory committee because no review issues raised significant public health questions regarding the risk:benefit assessment. Instead, three special government employees (two oncologists and a patient representative) were consulted individually by teleconference on July 11, 2019, and indicated the risk:benefit was favorable with no concerns about approval; because no committee was held, there are no committee concern-to-approval-change linkages.
